result.summary: Found 2 visual layout issues causing misalignment and cramped spacing.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the titles ('Green Bowl Poké', 'Smash Bros Burgers') and subtitles are vertically misaligned because the images have inconsistent heights.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent aspect ratio or uniform height to the images so the text below aligns correctly across all cards.

issues.description: The vertical spacing between the text at the bottom of the 'Fastest near you' carousel and the 'Popular right now' section heading is too tight, causing the elements to crowd each other.
issues.suggestion: Increase the bottom margin of the carousel section or add top margin to the 'Popular right now' heading to provide better visual separation.
